```{R, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
# prettify dataset
library(stringr)
mtcars$brand <- word(rownames(mtcars), 1)
#mtcars$brand <- sapply(rownames(mtcars), function(x){ x[, 6]})
mtcars$cyl <- as.factor(mtcars$cyl)
```


# Geoms



## Subtask 1

... and a figure!

```{R, echo=FALSE}
# format as gggrid?
grid.arrange(
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_bar(aes(x=cyl)),
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_density(aes(wt)),
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_point(aes(x=wt, y=mpg)),
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_smooth(aes(x=wt, y=mpg))
#	ggplot(mtcars) +
#		geom_point(aes(x=wt, y=(4.54/161)/mpg)) +
#		ylab("l/100km")
	)
```
```{R, echo=FALSE}
grid.arrange(
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_boxplot(aes(cyl, wt)) +
		geom_point(aes(x=cyl, y=wt, col=mpg, shape=brand)),
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_label(aes(x=hp, y=cyl, label=brand)),
		#geom_text(aes(x=hp, y=cyl, label=brand), check_overlap=TRUE),
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_bar(aes(cyl)),
	ggplot(mtcars) +
		geom_bar(aes(cyl)) +
		coord_polar(theta="x")
		)
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(iris) +
	geom_spoke(aes(x=0, y=0, col=Species, angle=Petal.Width/Petal.Length, radius=Petal.Length))
```
